_comment: E2 headline tier-stratified subset (24 prompts, 6/Level). Tiers heuristic by complexity (GETTING_STARTED L1-4 anchors); all chosen to map to DemoPDK cells so sim/DRC stages are reachable. Source: Testbench_modified.csv. Pending Poon-group tier review.

prompts.prompt: A 90 degree waveguide bend
A straight waveguide with a length of 253 um
A ring resonator, single bus, with a radius of 10 microns and a gap of 0.2 microns.
A directional coupler, with two inputs and two outputs and 50:50 split ratio
A power splitter, with one input and two outputs and 50:50 split ratio
Give me a 2x2 MMI with a gap of 500 nm between the inputs/outputs.
A directional coupler connected to a 2x2 MMI.
2 grating couplers connected by a straight waveguide
A grating coupler followed by a 1x2 MMI.
A mmi 1x2 followed by a mmi 2x2.
Connect one output port of a 1x2 MMI to an input of another 1x2 MMI
The output ports of an adiabatic directional coupler connected to two straight waveguides
A 2x2 MZI with a phase shifter in each arm for 1 GHz modulation.
Design a 2×2 MZI with two 2 mm long PIN-diodes, one in each arm, for phase modulation.
2x2 MZI with integrated heaters. the length of the MZI is 500um and the path length difference is 40um
Create a passive asymmetric Mach-Zehnder Interferometer at 1550 nm with a 300 µm path-length difference between arms. The MZI has one input and one output port both terminated in grating couplers.
Design a single-bus ring resonator (with a radius of 28) connected to two grating couplers for input/output coupling.
Connect a 2x2 MZI with integrated thermal heaters to a directional coupler with a length of 125 um, dy of 100 um, and dx of 100 um
Design a 1×16 power splitter using 4 stages of 1×2 MMI couplers such that each output port receives an equal share of the input power.
Layout a 1x4 power splitter using three 1x2MMIs. Add 4 thermo-optic phase shifters, one on each output arm, for independent tuning.
Cascaded 2x2 MZIs to create a switch tree network with 8 outputs.

Design a 4-channel wavelength demultiplexer using four ring resonators cascaded along a common bus waveguide. Each ring should have a radius of ~10 µm, and a 200 nm coupling gap. Provide drop ports for each ring to route the separated channels.”
Connect four amplitude modulators (each 1 in/1 out, >10 GHz electro-optic bandwidth) to a 4×1 wavelength-division multiplexer.

Design two cascaded double-bus silicon ring resonators, each with a 10 µm radius. In each ring, the top bus is for input/output and the bottom bus is for drop/through ports. The second ring’s input bus is connected to the drop port of the first ring, forming a serial filter chain. Each bus-to-ring gap is 200 nm.
